author: PBS Space Time
description:
The James Webb Space Telescope has discovered galaxies that appear far too massive and mature for the early universe, challenging our understanding of how quickly galaxies can evolve. Could rapidly growing supermassive black holes be the key to explaining how these ancient galaxies formed, stopped making stars, and grew up so fast?
